test_title: PYST 46: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the letter series

L_P_QS_K_P_S_KP_Q_L_ _PQS
solution:
Given series: L_P_QS_K_P_S_KP_Q_L_ _PQS

Option 1) KPLPQLPSKP→ L__**K**__P__**P**__QS__**L**__K__**P**__P__**Q**__S__**L**__KP__**P**__Q__**S**__L__**K**__ __**P**__PQS → (It follows the pattern of: LKPPQS - LKPPQS - LKPPQS - LKPPQS)

Option 2) KPLPLQLSPK → L__K__P__P__QS__L__K__P__P__L__S__Q__KP__L__Q__S__L__P__ __K__PQS → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) KPLPQQLPSK → L__K__P__P__QS__L__K__P__P__Q__S__Q__KP__L__Q__P__L__S__ __K__PQS → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) PKLPQPLSKP → L__P__P__K__QS__L__K__P__P__Q__S__P__KP__L__Q__S__L__K__ __P__PQS → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
